title: Matumizi ya -ako na –enu (Theme 5: Mnyama nimpendaye)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 2 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child finds the word the grammar point depends on (the person, the noun and its ngeli, one or many) before choosing the form.

floor.prerequisite: Names everyday things and people in Kiswahili.
floor.question: Hiki ni nini? (kiti)

representations: picture and word cards sorted by ngeli or person
colour matching of the parts that agree
a short passage on mnyama nimpendaye using the words
steps: Ask: one or many? Which ngeli or person?
contexts: a game with real objects in class
talking with a parent at home

board.do: Paka wako ni mweupe; paka wenu ni weusi.
Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child makes his own sentence with the form and reads it aloud.

misconceptions.repair: Kitabu changu; kiti chake: kimilikishi hufuata ngeli. (wako)
Mwenye kitu ni nani? Mimi: changu; yeye: chake; wao: chao. (yenu)
Nomino kwanza, kimilikishi baadaye: kalamu yangu. (paka wako)
